established: The 1994 lubrication description specifies a rotor-type pump and spring-loaded bypass returning oil to the intake side.
The 1994 catalog lists pump C5AZ6600A, pickup E3TZ6622F and intermediate shaft C5AZ6A618A.
The industrial parts book PDF pages 17–18 lists the same C5AZ-6600-A pump and four cover bolts, but a different C5TZ-6622-B pickup.
The 1994 rotor inspection image shows a four-lobed inner rotor; the five-lobed companion arrangement is interpreted from the drawing. Exact curves are not supplied.
